description: Score the project's .faf with faf-cli's scorer — the one score every faf tool reports: 0–100%, the tier, populated/active slots, and a faf-parity/v1 hash of the result. details: true lists every slot as populated, empty or slotignored. Reads only. Use faf_doctor for what to fix.

details.description: List every slot as populated, empty or slotignored, and the tools that fill the empty ones

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

name: faf_score

outputSchema.description: Structured AI-readiness score, single-sourced from faf-cli.

hasFaf.description: Whether a readable, valid project.faf was scored

ignored.description: Slots marked slotignored (inactive for this app_type)

inherited.description: True if the score is attested from a source repo (an about: block)

nextTier.description: Next tier above the current score, or null at top tier

parity.description: faf-parity/v1 — claude-faf-mcp's own spec (no other engine computes it yet): sha256 over a canonical projection of faf-cli's score for these exact bytes. Check it yourself: sha256(projection) === parityHash.

producedBy.description: The server that emitted this receipt (metadata, not hashed)

projection.description: The exact canonical string that was hashed (for verification)

scorer.description: The single deterministic source the score comes from (faf-cli)

score.description: AI-readiness score, 0-100 (-1 only together with unknown: true)

tier.description: Tier name for this score (e.g. BRONZE, TROPHY)

unknown.description: True when the score is not known: an About repo with no about.source_score. Shown as "unknown (—)", never as a number.

title: Score .faf
